title: SPCX Stock Declines As Investors Weigh AI Investment Scale Despite Upbeat Q2 Earnings
key_facts: SpaceX shares fell 8% after hours after Q2 results
Q2 revenue USD 7.8 billion, up 92% from USD 4.1 billion a year earlier
Net loss narrowed to USD 541 million from USD 1.0 billion
Total capex USD 18.4 billion, of which AI USD 15.8 billion (Colossus II compute)
AI segment revenue up 247% to USD 2.6 billion; Starlink subscribers doubled to 12 million
USD 100 billion in cash and securities; USD 60 billion agreement to acquire Cursor announced in the quarter
Shares trade near USD 125 versus the USD 135 IPO price
quote_evidence: SpaceX shares fell 8% in after-hours trading on Tuesday after the newly public company reported second-quarter results that beat revenue expectations but left investors focused on heavy spending.
notes: Older news re-dated: the article says the results came "on Tuesday" and Google News coverage (Fortune, 4 Aug 2026; Reuters, CBS and qz.com, 5 Aug 2026) places the first SpaceX earnings report in early August. Stocktwits page date of 4 Oct 2026 is a republish. The page quotes a share price around USD 125, below the USD 135 IPO price.
